resolution.note: Write and Bash /dev/../ targets into another repository are refused; test fails without the fix

title: A lane's /dev/.. path cannot write into another repository
body:
Source: operator-forwarded weekly code review 2026-11-19 (800 PRs since 2026-11-12, deep pass on ship gate, lane write guard, CI). Evidence: src/hook/scope.ts:343 and :305 skip any target starting with /dev/ before normalizing, so Write /dev/../home/other/repo/a.ts and 'echo x > /dev/../...' are allowed while /home/other/repo/a.ts is refused.
Files: src/hook/scope.ts, test/hook/scope.test.ts
Outcome: every write target is resolved before the /dev/ test in both guards; a /dev/.. path to another repository is refused like its plain form.
Proof: `node --test test/hook/scope.test.ts: pass` with Write and Bash /dev/../ targets refused.
